## Student outreach brief — official sources

- **Lewis & Clark (San Diego admissions):** Lewis & Clark’s California counselor listing assigns **Qwadere Lovell** to San Diego-area applicants. The Admissions office contact listed with that resource is **admissions@lclark.edu**; college main phone is **503-768-7000**. [California admissions-counselor listing](https://college.lclark.edu/admissions/staff/counties/) *(the search-indexed official listing identifies Lovell; the college’s current site structure may redirect the old listing).*  

- **Hunter / Silberman MSW, Fall 2026:** The published Fall MSW deadline is **March 1** for the application and **March 15** for supporting documents. This applies to the listed two-year full-time, dual-degree Bank Street, advanced-standing, and one-year residency options. [Silberman deadlines](https://sssw.hunter.cuny.edu/admissions/deadlines/)

- **IU Kokomo graduate programs:** IU Kokomo says its graduate offerings span **master’s degrees, graduate certificates, and postbaccalaureate work**. Examples shown in its academic directory include the **MBA in Business Administration**, **Master of Arts for Teachers in Biology (100% online)**, and graduate certificates in **Alcohol and Drug Counseling** and **Biology**. [Graduate-program hub](https://kokomo.iu.edu/graduate-programs/index.html) | [academic program directory](https://www.iuk.edu/academics/index.html)

- **Two recruiting UCSF glioblastoma trials in Northern California:**  
  1. **Anti-EGFRvIII synNotch Receptor Induced Anti-EphA2/IL-13Ralpha2 CAR (E-SYNC) T Cells** — Phase I; open to eligible adults; listed in **San Francisco**.  
  2. **DOC1021 Dendritic Cell Immunotherapy for Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Adult Glioblastoma (GBM)** — open to eligible adults; listed in **San Francisco and other locations**.  
  [UCSF glioblastoma trials](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/glioblastoma)  
  *UCSF’s page currently labels both “open to eligible people”; eligibility should be confirmed with the study team.*

- **Oral Roberts University student activities/student-experience contact:** ORU’s current staff page does not use the exact title “Student Activities Director.” Its closest current leadership role is **Chandler Petrak, M.Div., Director of Spiritual Life & Student Experience** — **cpetrak@oru.edu**, **918-495-6664**. [ORU Student Life team](https://oru.edu/life-at-oru/student-life/meet-the-team.php)

- **EDF graduate programme / salary reviews:** **No.** EDF’s current [Graduate careers page](https://careers.edfenergy.com/graduate-careers) does **not** state that new graduate hires receive salary reviews. It describes programmes, application stages, support, and benefits, but contains no salary-review commitment.
